data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Batch push notifications and In-App messages.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to build communication experiences in your app through personalized push notifications and In-App messages using Batch's Native SDKs. Supports rich profile attributes, topics, and messaging features.
use_when: You need to integrate Batch push notifications into a Flutter application.
You want to display In-App messages and automation powered by Batch.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase Cloud Messaging exclusively without Batch.
Your application does not require external push notification services.
strengths: Direct integration with Batch native SDKs for iOS and Android.
Supports advanced features like user profiles, topic preferences, and In-App messages.
weaknesses: Requires managing native SDK dependencies and platform-specific prerequisites.
Limited alternatives inside the catalog since it is vendor-locked to Batch.
data.setup_notes: Requires following native setup documentation for Android and iOS, including configuring Batch native SDK requirements.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative push notification service provider with its own Flutter SDK.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Firebase Cloud Messaging instead of Batch for push notifications.
